notes.title: Demo gameplay update #1
notes.content: [p]Thank you so much for everyone downloading and playing the demo! And thanks especially to those of you with feedback. Discord PMs and the community hub have received bug reports and feature requests and we've been implementing them.[/p][p][/p][h3]Balance:[/h3][list][*][p]Retaliations from corporations start earlier now, on turn 2[/p][/*][*][p]Retaliations are much more powerful and hurt the player a lot[/p][/*][*][p]Developed technology is much more powerful (selection is very limited compared to the full game though)[/p][/*][*][p]Corporations get beefier quicker and start to take out competition earlier[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of life:[/h3][list][*][p]Operations options on a celestial can now be seen when [b][u]hovering[/u][/b] instead of clicking (we probably will add a toggle for this system in the full game if it gains traction in the demo)[/p][/*][*][p]Filtering all operations and hovering over choices now hilights and brings the hovered options to front making the tool much easier to use[/p][/*][*][p]Added a UI scaling option for those players who have trouble with the font size (the UI is autoscaled to higher resolutions BUT it's not infallible and at least for ultra wide it's a bit of a hit and miss) - it's a bit of an experimental feature as of now and some UI elements might clash in an ugly way[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to start the game from Steam with Vulkan rendering - there were issues with a few players with DX12[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New look, new trailer and upcoming open beta
notes.content: [h2]Secret handshake![/h2][p]We've been hard at work here, but can't really tell what we've been doing, because it's cosmic top secret. However, we have released a new trailer with some update visuals. And also updated the screenshots.[/p][p][/p][h3]New features incoming[/h3][p]We ran an external alpha test with good, actionable feedback and are now working on some new features for mid and late game. Namely, a RETALIATION SYSTEM! Corporations will strike back at you for failing in your operations and they might even blow up your operators. Stay tuned for some images![/p][p][/p][h3]Open beta[/h3][p]In three to four weeks, we'll be opening up a registrations for our open beta test via Steam's playtest feature. If you are keen to try the game out before we launch our demo, be sure to follow these updates. We'll be posting it only on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, keep yourselves discrete and under the radar.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Prepare your hidden cameras and quantum code crackers
notes.content:
[h3]Hello all![/h3]

Fancy Raven Games is a small indie studio from Helsinki, Finland. We are really excited to announce our game: Interstellar Espionage Inc. Check our announce trailer and stay tuned for more!

The game is far from being finished, so expect a lot of updates in the upcoming months. And prepare yourselves for public playtesting and a demo after summer.

We'd love if you left us feedback in any shape or form. It helps us make them game so much better so we can serve you - the audience - better.
